description: Ochranné pásmo ropovodov: Ukladacia služba is a dataset listed in INSPIRE Discovery Service Slovakia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by maps.geocloud.sk. Oil pipeline protection zone. Coverage: SK. The portal shows the English title as "Oil pipeline protection zone: Storage service" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.sk). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-csw-sk.
